inlines.v: MA'INOR, noun [ Latin a manu, from the hand, or in the work.] The old law phrase, to be taken as a thief with the mainor signifies, to be taken in the very act of killing venison or stealing wood, or in preparing so to do; or it denotes the being taken with the thing stolen upon him.
